the plan removes pyyaml and accepts only quoted block-list and quoted flow-list forms, but the current contract accepts any `yaml.safe_load` `paths` list, including unquoted yaml list entries and aliases after validation. a rule file that passes today can fail after the move, violating the explicit keep-behavior-identical scope and breaking pre-commit or agent-sync.

a quote-only flow extractor on `paths: ["skills/foo.md", 3, null, true]` (harness k) can return just `skills/foo.md` and exit 0 instead of failing with `must be a string`. treating scalar `paths: skills/foo.md` (harness j) as a one-element list bypasses the current `yaml.safe_load` list check and `paths must be a list` diagnostic.

if the plan deletes the three harnesses and adds them to `migrated-scripts.tsv`, `make lint-retired-scripts` will still find their literals in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` because deleted harness paths remain in the shellcheck hook `files` list.

retiring `scripts/render-session-transcript.py` without replacing the `_render_transcript.is_file()` availability probe leaves `capture_transcript` recording render-failed unavailable on every implement run, even though `python/cli.py run-log render-session-transcript` exists.

repointing to `python/cli.py run-log render-session-transcript` without requiring an absolute entrypoint risks regression: `capture_transcript_main` inherits caller cwd, so a relative `python/cli.py` path can fail when cwd is not repo root, whereas the old script path was absolute via `_render_transcript`.
